name: proxi_alignment
title: PROXI alignment (reconcile the car's configuration)
intent: Reads the CAN configuration, compares it with the module roster and writes the Body computer's PROXI data so every module agrees. Needed after a module is replaced or reprogrammed.
summary: Reads the CAN configuration, compares it with the module roster and writes the Body computer's PROXI data so every module agrees. Needed after a module is replaced or reprogrammed.
status_note: steps is EMPTY on purpose: no bytes, identifiers or procedures are invented. Fill steps only from the manufacturer's documented procedure and cite it in source.

session.note: bus and bitrate are the confirmed CAN-C values; the diagnostic session comes with the manufacturer's documented steps

read_back.label: No read method for the current value is known. The manufacturer must supply one so a before and after can be proven.

conditions: unknown until documented. docs/design/CUORE_ADJUSTMENTS_PLAN.md notes MES advises battery support; the manufacturer must confirm.

preconditions.label: unknown until documented. docs/design/CUORE_ADJUSTMENTS_PLAN.md notes MES advises battery support; the manufacturer must confirm.

verification_rule: Unknown until the manufacturer documents a read method. Nothing is claimed.
needs_from_manufacturer: The manufacturer's documented alignment procedure for the 952 and 949, including the node roster rules and which result means 'not needed'.
Preconditions (battery support, engine state), cable or gateway use, failure handling and the restore path for a backed-up configuration.
A read method for the current value, so a before and after can be proven.
Written authority for CUORE to write it, then the existing path: dry run, gate, typed consent, read-back, audit.

evidence.source: docs/design/CUORE_ADJUSTMENTS_PLAN.md Part 2 (MES menu CAN Setup / PROXI ALIGNMENT PROCEDURE (952); MES decides by reading the CAN configuration and comparing the node roster)

docs/project/ALFAOBD_GAP.md section 1 item 15; https://www.giuliaforums.com/threads/alfaobd-for-proxi-alignment.58085/ (AlfaOBD names 'Proxy alignment'; forum reports it working on Android, another owner reports failure partway on some modules)
docs/project/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-29 (owner moved PROXI alignment into CUORE)

follow_up: Other write functions that change BCM configuration (paddle market, battery type) require this alignment afterwards (docs/project/ALFAOBD_GAP.md section 3).

risks.risk: A failed or partial alignment can leave modules disagreeing; CUORE's own notes record a TCM P1500 limp-in on mismatch, and the BCM already stores B10AA-4A on the reference car.
Do not align when the tool reports the car is properly configured.
